package shapes;

public class Outer {
    private int value = 1;

    static class Nested {
        int nestedField;
        int read() { return nestedField; }
    }

    class Inner {
        int read() { return value; }
    }

    interface Shape {
        double AREA_SCALE = 2.0;
        double area();
        default String label() { return "shape"; }
    }

    enum Color {
        RED(1) {
            @Override
            int weight() { return 10; }
        },
        GREEN(2);

        private final int code;

        Color(int code) { this.code = code; }

        int weight() { return code; }
    }

    record Point(int x, int y) {
        Point {
            if (x < 0) { throw new IllegalArgumentException(); }
        }

        int sum() { return x + y; }
    }

    void run() {
        class Local {
            int z;
        }
        Runnable task = new Runnable() {
            int count;
            public void run() { count++; }
        };
        task.run();
    }
}
